Titagarh Rail Systems Secures JSW Wagon Order and Naval Vessel Delivery

Titagarh Rail Systems has secured an order from JSW for wagons valued at ₹77 crore. The company also delivered a naval vessel and received clearance for auto carrier wagons. The order from JSW is for wagons, and the clearance pertains to auto carrier wagons.
